lines: To the Unserved who serves the threefold singly
to all men's darling, who desires nought, to Tangle-locks — hail.
sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine

lines: Lo, the saints' field-sense for high emprise,
whereby these sow deathless-fruited love in thee, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho

lines: Ah, ample thy glamour, O Trickster — wherein shrouded,
the dazed delay though thought's hoard on thee be gained.
sanskrit_cite: mahatīyam aho māyā tava māyin yayāvṛtaḥ tvaddhyānanidhilābhe 'pi mugdho lokaḥ ślathāyate

lines: At each emprise, Bhava — deed, tool, cosmos be as they be,
the unbound maker there is thee alone.
sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

lines: Clutched by tri-strand triple-throb twins, the triple spheres:
to haul them, save thee, whose force, whose ruth?
sanskrit_cite: triguṇatriparispandadvandvagrastaṃ jagattrayam uddhartuṃ bhavato 'nyasya kasya śaktiḥ kṛpāthavā

lines: What taint is taint in souls set to attain thee, e'en Lord?
what worth is worth, pray, in souls set never to attain? Be passion mine, world-Lord, on thee alone reposed — yea, homage to my greed, leashed to gain of thee.
sanskrit_cite: doṣo 'pideva ko doṣas tvām āptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ guṇo 'pi ca guṇaḥ ko nu tvāṃ nāptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ rāgo 'py astu jagannātha mama tvayy eva yaḥ sthitaḥ lobhāyāpi namas tasmai tvallābhālambanāya me

lines: Ah, mighty this observance, God, brooding thee throughout —
therein, from Firstborn to grub, who lacks title to release?
sanskrit_cite: aho mahad idaṃ karma deva tvadbhāvanātmakam ābrahmakrimi yasmin no muktaye 'dhikriyeta kaḥ

lines: Alpha of all deeds, omega of all rites, the motley midst between,
thine indeed, O Master, on wit's highway.
sanskrit_cite: ārambhaḥ sarvakāryāṇām paryantaḥ sarvakarmaṇām tadantarvṛttayaś citrās tavaiveśo dhiyaḥ pathi

lines: While higher swells the thousandfold tide of savour,
past love-juice for thee, Lord, nowhere is it found.
sanskrit_cite: yāvad uttaram āsvādasahasraguṇavistaraḥ tvadbhaktirasapīyūṣān nātha nānyatra dṛśyate
